context.transcript:
As you know, in March, our marketing agency won the industry award for most innovative television commercial.
After years of hard work, we're now an established name and business is thriving.
One of the individuals who has contributed significantly throughout our path to success is Scott Williams.
So, it's with some reluctance that I'm announcing that Scott has decided to embark on his retirement.
It's certainly a loss for us, and we will miss his valuable insights.
In light of this change, we'll need to modify a project team.
Lauren is already successfully heading the marketing campaign for the Greyrock Financial Account, so we're going to add her expertise to the Stelco Technologies Account also.
context.transcript_translation:
正如你所知，三月份我们的营销机构赢得了最具创新性的电视广告行业奖项。
经过多年的辛勤工作，我们现在已成为一个知名的品牌，并且业务蓬勃发展。
在我们走向成功的过程中，有一个人做出了重要贡献，他就是斯科特·威廉姆斯。
因此，我怀着些许犹豫宣布斯科特决定退休。
对我们来说这无疑是一个损失，我们会想念他的宝贵见解。
鉴于这一变化，我们需要调整一个项目团队。
劳伦已经成功地负责了Greyrock金融账户的营销活动，所以我们打算将她的专业知识也应用于Stelco技术公司账户。
